detailed_description:

The camera performs exactly one smooth clockwise 360-degree orbit around the completely stationary <swordswoman>, at constant radius, constant elevation, constant focal length, constant speed, and constant framing, ending at the starting viewpoint. The surrounding street stays in place in the world and is revealed consistently as the camera moves, continuing the same location seen in <Picture 1>, drawn in the same black-and-white ink and screentone manga style. No articulation, deformation, secondary motion, wind, zoom, dolly, camera roll, cuts, lighting changes, or scene changes.

The entire subject is a single frozen three-dimensional scene throughout the shot. Every visible eyelid keeps its reference position: no blinking. Each eye keeps a fixed gaze relative to the head and never tracks the moving camera. Facial expression, mouth, head, hands, feet and body pose remain unchanged. Hair strands, clothing, ribbons, accessories and loose parts are rigidly fixed in the same positions. There is no breathing, sway, settling or secondary motion. Only the camera changes position. Camera radius, focal length and look-at point stay fixed. Lighting stays fixed in world space; normal viewpoint-dependent shading and reflections remain physically consistent.
